page.notes: Væstiones[?]: the first word of the list is unclear; probably Quæstiones, with the Q drawn like a V. Page number 500 and running head read from a small, worn print. "fine fit" in item 4 is read as printed and may be "fine sit". "remiss." at the line end is uncertain; it may be remissa with a broken word. "certò" carries a grave accent as printed. The woodcut initial is not text. No marginal notes on this page. The catchword "anima" is set in italic at the bottom right.
